newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Oct 17:
SAN JOSE - Apple Computer Inc. defied Wall Street by returning to profitability in the fourth quarter, a period that analysts had expected to end with the company's fourth straight quarterly loss.
WASHINGTON - Sixteen years after Congress deregulated the railroad industry and sent it into an era of prosperity, a fear is growing in boardrooms that the upcoming Congress might change course.
WASHINGTON - Prescription drug sales are flourishing but the boom is largely bypassing the corner drugstore in favour of mail-order pharmacies.
